assert.//: Accessibility is the hard gate (the original intent of categories:accessibility=error). The previous lighthouse:recommended preset also asserted minScore on opportunity audits that emit no score (lcp-lazy-loaded, prioritize-lcp-image, non-composited-animations -> NaN), required zero unused CSS/JS (impossible), and counted network 404s from the backend-less static serve (errors-in-console) -- none of which are passable here. Performance is reported but not gated because it is measured against a cold static serve with no backend.
